articles.title: Attorney for banned outlets on legal fight over White House press access
articles.whatHappened: A federal judge has once again ordered the White House to restore access for three news organizations President Trump banned last month over their coverage of his administration. The judge ordered full access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico while their legal challenge moves forward. Geoff Bennett discussed more with Ted Boutrous, the attorney representing the three outlets.
articles.significance: Judicial & Constitutional Impact: Sets a key legal precedent affecting federal enforcement, constitutional rights, and how lower courts interpret national law.

articles.title: News Wrap: Trump says Fort Hood shooter's execution will not be livestreamed
articles.whatHappened: In our news wrap Thursday, President Trump canceled plans to livestream the December execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, federal law enforcement agencies are investigating a series of letters containing what they're calling "suspicious substances" that were sent to congressional and state election officials and police report multiple victims in a shooting at a school in Bend, Oregon.

articles.title: Wisconsin elections officials issue guidance for handling federal agents at polls
articles.whatHappened: Elections officials in battleground Wisconsin on Thursday approved guidance for local clerks to help them know what to do if federal law enforcement officials show up at the polls on Election Day, as some activists fear might happen.
